name: Entity Concept
idea: The business is separate from its owners.

name: Accounting Period (Periodicity) Concept
idea: Profit is measured in regular periods.

name: Money Measurement Concept
idea: Record only what can be measured in money.

name: Historical Cost Concept
idea: Record assets at what they cost.

name: Consistency Concept
idea: Keep the same methods year to year.

name: Accrual (Revenue Recognition) Concept
idea: Record revenue when earned, not when cash arrives.

name: Matching Concept
idea: Expenses go with the revenue they helped earn.

name: Dual Aspect Concept
idea: Every transaction has two equal sides.

name: Conservatism (Prudence)
idea: Recognise likely losses, not hoped-for gains.

name: Materiality
idea: Small items need no special treatment.

name: Full Disclosure
idea: Share all material information in the notes.
